audit.whatIsWrong: The poke ability is called 'Mercury Cannon Q acceleration gate' in six places, as if that were one ability.
audit.why: It is three different slots run together. Mercury Cannon is the R-form swap. The poke is Shock Blast, the cannon-form Q. Acceleration Gate is the cannon-form E, and Riot's text says 'If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.' Naming them separately is not pedantry here: the gate hitting the ground is the tell that the next Q is the long, fast, hard-hitting version, and a player who thinks it is all one ability has no tell to watch for.
audit.corrected: Shock Blast (cannon Q) fired through Acceleration Gate (cannon E). The gate landing is your cue to move, several tenths of a second before the Q exists.
sources: champ-data/_kits/jayce.json (Q, E, R name arrays and E description)

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Jayce's hammer form burst combo (W empowered Q + E knockback gate)' and later '(E knockback into gate, then Q empowered slam)'.
audit.why: There is no W-empowered Q. In hammer stance W is Lightning Field, a damage aura around him; Hyper Charge is the cannon-stance W. The knockback is Thundering Blow, the hammer E — and Acceleration Gate is the cannon E, so 'E knockback gate' fuses the two stances into one non-existent ability. His actual hammer burst is the R-swap bonus-damage first attack, To the Skies!, Lightning Field and Thundering Blow.
audit.corrected: Hammer burst = R-swap bonus hit, To the Skies!, Lightning Field, Thundering Blow knockback.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states what Blinding Dart is and is not worth against Jayce.
audit.why: Every point of Jayce's cannon-form output is ability damage — Shock Blast and Hyper Charge-boosted attacks — and Shock Blast is a skillshot. A blind does nothing to the poke that is actually killing the Teemo. It is only worth its 7 seconds once he swaps to hammer and wants to auto. That reframes the entire early game from 'blind him' to 'hold Q for hammer form'.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart does nothing to Shock Blast. Hold it for the moment he swaps to Mercury Hammer and wants to auto you.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers for the ability the matchup is named after.
audit.why: Jayce's Q ranks six times, 16/14/12/10/8/6, and E is 20/18/16/14/12/10 — unusually long early, which is why the level 1-3 poke war is survivable and why he is far more oppressive once those are ranked up.
audit.corrected: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 and only 6s at rank 6; Acceleration Gate is 20s down to 10s. Early on, a dodged Q buys you a long time.
sources: champ-data/_kits/jayce.json (Q and E cooldowns, six ranks)

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's Level 1 row is sided to Jayce but its why reads 'AA-poke + E poison wins almost every melee level 1.'
audit.why: Jayce is not melee at level 1 — in cannon stance he outranges everything Teemo owns. The boilerplate contradicts the row it is attached to.
audit.corrected: Reworded to say what actually happens: Shock Blast outranges everything you have, so concede the level 1 poke war.

The danger zone is letting him land a full Mercury Hammer burst combo (E knockback into gate, then Q empowered slam) uncontested in an unshoomed corridor, because at two items his burst can drop you before your Move Quick gets you clear. Play the split through shroom-warded corridors, never stand in a spot he can gate-Q through the acceleration field, and force him to choose between losing the side lane to you or wasting his ult-roam timing fighting a poisoned mushroom field.

notes: This matchup had the messiest ability naming of my slice: Mercury Cannon (R), Shock Blast (cannon Q) and Acceleration Gate (cannon E) were fused into a single phrase, and the hammer combo was described with a W-empowered Q that does not exist in either stance. Jayce is the one champion here whose two stances share slots, so a name-checking script that only compares against a single name per slot will keep missing these — his kit file carries two names per slot and both need to be in the checker's vocabulary.
